verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents encrypted, vault-stored secrets for apps and org-wide credential management for Sprites: connect once for the whole org, scope access by name, label or endpoint, and rotate centrally. The evidence covers centralized credentials, not team member access control or environment variables. Missing for 10: documented team/org member roles or RBAC for human users, environment-variable management beyond secrets, org-level secrets for Fly Apps (not just Sprites), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.
Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint
Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential.
Secrets allow sensitive values, such as credentials, to be passed securely to your Fly App. The secret is encrypted and stored in a vault.
